rule_text: Endpoints that read, update, or delete user-owned resources must enforce authorization on the server side. Deny access by default when permission is missing or unclear.
safe_patterns: Use middleware or helper functions like `requireUser`, `requireRole`, or `canAccessResource`.
title: Authorization: Deny By Default And Check Permissions Server-Side
unsafe_patterns: API route reads `user_id`, `owner_id`, `account_id`, or `project_id` from the client and directly queries data
